description: Export Steam raw files into normalized interaction/item tables and three k-core density regimes.
notes: User-item playtime is the primary implicit interaction source.
Review dates are attached only when the review has the same user_id and item_id.
Steam user-item playtime records do not include timestamps, so temporal split requires the review subset or a separate split policy.
The default export caps interactions at 2,000,000 for a first manageable density-design pass.
